name: Action Legal Video, Inc.

description: Action Legal Video is a South Florida-based legal videography firm specializing in video depositions, trial presentations, and settlement summaries for attorneys and law firms handling criminal and civil litigation. The company distinguishes itself through highly trained and certified videographers, state-of-the-art equipment, and professional service delivery across medical malpractice, personal injury, and construction cases throughout South Florida. Their comprehensive approach combines accurate testimony preservation with strategic case presentation support to help counsel evaluate cases before mediation and trial.

description: NAEGELI Deposition & Trial is a Miami-based court reporting and litigation support firm that has been the trusted partner of Florida's legal community since 1980, offering comprehensive services including depositions, videography, real-time reporting, and same-day rough transcripts. Their nationally recognized court reporters are known for producing precise transcripts with flexible scheduling and 24/7 client support to accommodate any case needs. What sets them apart is their award-winning team's commitment to quality and reliability, combined with convenient online scheduling and a full suite of litigation support services designed to strengthen legal cases.
